import json, re
with open('docs/feature/wp1.md') as f:
    content = f.read()

blocks = re.findall(r'\`\`\`json\n(.*?)```', content, re.DOTALL)
if not blocks:
    print('FAIL: no json block found')
else:
    last = blocks[-1].strip()
    try:
        data = json.loads(last)
        tasks = data['tasks']
        print(f'OK: valid JSON, {len(tasks)} tasks')
        for t in tasks:
            print(f\"  {t['id']}: {t['title'][:60]}... deps={t['deps']} files={t['files']}\")
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        print(f'FAIL: invalid JSON: {e}')
        print('Block content:', last[:500])
"
